# D2.js 0.1.34

`d2.js` is `dist/browser/index.js` from the npm package [@d2lang/d2](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@d2lang/d2) 0.1.34,
unmodified. It bundles the WebAssembly build of [D2](https://d2lang.com) v0.9.0.

`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`.
